ST-02.notes: Commit 540887b9. Deviation check vs positions.md v2.25 §Responsive Behavior (Table v2.25 row) and design record §4: none. ST-03.title: Combine the four banners above the Positions table into one strip
ST-03.notes: Commits: 99f16e6d (implementation, spec, existing-spec updates), 360bf177 (SC-LBG-03 opens the grace entry after CI run 43288957471 shard 3/8 failed). Deviation check vs positions.md v2.25 §Warning Strip and design record §6: none. Implementation notes (intent-matching, LL-v3.4-P3-03): the staleness entry is active whenever MetricsStalenessIndicator would render, which includes the fresh 'Data as of N mins ago' state (literal reading of the spec's 'Active when'; keeps SC-STALE-04); the drawdown content keeps its session dismiss, which now removes the drawdown entry; the grace entry is also activated by grace-period alerts when GET /positions is empty or failed; before ST-04 the grace content showed a line when no position was within 2 days of the end. Pre-commit /code-review medium: 7 findings fixed in 99f16e6d, 1 declined with reason (memoising the entries array). CI on 360bf177: all workflows success; Playwright E2E Acceptance Tests run 43289954700 success (step 4c); CI Pytest Suite 43289955322; Frontend Production Build success on 99f16e6d (run 43288957562).

ST-04.title: Show grace period in one place, linked from the others
ST-04.notes: Commits: 661cc4ee (implementation), d11ff814 (Risk Dashboard grace panel lines at about 2:1 contrast in light mode, found by the agent-mediated DoQ review; SC-POSGV-08 hardened to fail on axe 'incomplete'; ended-grace 'next ends' fix; deviation heading). CI on d11ff814: all 9 workflows success; Playwright E2E run 43301555472; Frontend Production Build 43301555497. Further filings: BLG-SPEC-235, BLG-FE-292. Deviation filed: DEV-EPIC01-ST04-01 (P3, positions.md Known Deviations; BLG-BE-215) - rows with more than 2 days of grace left show no trade plan line, because GET /positions/grace-period-alerts returns only rows with 2 days or fewer. Design gate obligations met: grace_alert_dismissed_* reads removed; positions.md v2.26 §Grace Period Alert Zone is a 'Superseded' stub. Implementation notes (intent-matching): the Risk Dashboard next-end line uses n - 1 ('Next ends in 1 day' for 2; 'Ends today' for 1; 'Grace period has ended' for 0) to agree with the strip's date - spec wording filed as BLG-SPEC-234; alert-only rows (grace just ended, or GET /positions empty) are listed; the expanded-row Grace pill stays (design §5.2) and renders only when a row is opened, so SC-POSGV-07's 'only element' check holds on default views. Pre-commit /code-review medium: 5 findings fixed in-commit; filed BLG-BE-215, BLG-FE-291, BLG-SPEC-234. Local Playwright on an E2E-env production build: 173 passed, 1 skipped (existing SC-GPL-01 fixme). CI on 661cc4ee: all 9 workflows success; Playwright E2E Acceptance Tests run 43293797244 (step 4c); CI Pytest Suite 43293797711; Frontend Production Build 43293797748.
